name: Rugproof
description: Smart contract security auditor for Claude Code — vuln detection, exploit PoCs, mainnet-fork simulation, audit cards, on-chain certificates. Solidity + Vyper · 38 commands · 19 agents · 33 skills · 9 MCP servers.
longDescription:
Ships **45 skills**, **23 agents**, **45 commands** and **13 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (45): `access-control` (Detect missing or incorrect access control — missing modifiers, wrong role checks, privileged function exposure, public initializers, and…), `approval-issues` (Detect ERC-20 approval pitfalls — approve race (front-run), missing safeApprove, infinite approvals, approval-without-revoke, Permit2 misuse, max-approval to untrusted…), `caching-and-incremental` (Always-on meta-skill — cache audit results per file by content hash so unchanged files aren't re-analyzed on subsequent…), `centralization-risk` (Detect centralization and trust-assumption risks — admin powers, single-key risk, missing timelocks, upgrade authority, treasury keys, pause permanence,…), `confidence-scoring` (Always-on meta-skill — for every finding produced, attach a confidence level (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) and a reasoning trace), `cosmwasm` (Detect bug classes specific to CosmWasm (Rust) contracts — missing info.sender authorization in execute handlers, unbounded map iteration…), `cross-chain-messaging` (Detect cross-chain messaging bugs — replay protection gaps, untrusted-remote acceptance, default-config inheritance, validator-set misconfig, force-include vulnerabilities, chainId /…), `cross-contract-state` (Detect cross-contract state inconsistency — two or more contracts sharing a token, oracle, or price feed where one…), and 37 more
- **Agents** (23): `aa-specialist` (Account-Abstraction (ERC-4337) specialist), `amm-specialist` (AMM-specific audit specialist), `assembly-auditor` (Specialist for inline assembly / Yul), `attacker` (Adversarial reviewer), `bridge-specialist` (Bridge-specific specialist), `crosschain-messaging-specialist` (Specialist for cross-chain messaging primitives — LayerZero V2, Chainlink CCIP, Hyperlane, Wormhole, Axelar, Polyhedra ZKBridge, native rollup messengers), `defender` (Blue team), `economic-rug-specialist` (Rug-pull, tokenomics, and centralization deep-dive), and 15 more
- **Commands** (45): `audit-changes` (Audit only the git diff vs main (or specified base)), `audit-deep` (Deep audit — same as /audit but spawns more parallel subagents, runs multi-pass review, and chases exploit chains…), `audit-deps` (Audit third-party dependencies — resolve installed versions, cross-reference known-vulnerable releases, and flag vendored code that has diverged from…), `audit-diff` (Diff two Rugproof audit reports (before vs after) to track regressions — what's new, what's fixed, and whether…), `audit-history` (Pull past public audits (Code4rena, Sherlock, Spearbit, etc.) for a deployed contract or known protocol), `audit-live` (Audit a deployed contract on a live chain), `audit-multi-chain` (Diff the on-chain configuration of one contract deployed across multiple chains — owner, oracle, fees, timelock, pause state,…), `audit-strict` (Multi-pass consensus audit — runs the audit twice with different prompts, only reports consensus findings), and 37 more
- **MCP servers** (13): `block-explorer`, `forge-runner`, `hardhat-runner`, `anvil`, `tenderly`, `c4-history`, `sherlock-history`, `gas-tracker`, and 5 more

Installs with `claude plugin install rugproof@claude-community` from `omermaksutii/RugProof`.
